de 'dra lan gsum rdzogs mtshams/ lag pa gnyis mdun du rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ de mgo mjug slog pa spyi bo'i steng du bzhag la/ lang zhing dgang 'then gyis rlung stod du 'dren/ de nas phyag rgya de bkrol la/ 'phongs la brdeg pa dang mnyam du rlung rgyu zhabs su mnan no// de dag gi skabs su gegs sel ba la/ ha ring dang ha thung 'don pa gnyis la/ dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo'i steng du bzhag la/ ro stod rgur zhing ha zhes 'don/ de nas ro stod bskyang la bcangs phrag rgyag pa dang mnyam du ha drag tu 'don par byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ spyi dang 'dra'o// (272)gzhan yang gegs sel zhing bogs 'don pa la/ rab skor ni/ 'jam rlung bzung la/ lto ba g.yas su lan gsum bzhi tsam bskor/ g.yon du lan gsum bzhi tsam bskor/ de nas rlung phyir bus la phyi rol du bzung zhing*/ khog nang gis shugs de nyid g.yas g.yon du lan gsum tsam bskor ba ni nang bskor dang*/ phyi bskor ba ni/ mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa brkyangs te phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang*/ lag pa g.yon la yang de dang 'dra'o// de nas langs la thog mar rkang pa g.yas phyi nang lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang*/ de nas g.yon pa'ang phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang*/ de nas 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o// brdeg pa ni/ rlung bzung la steng gi shugs dbus dang mdun dang*/ g.yas dang*/ g.yon dang*/ rgyab tu rten par byed pa'o// de nas rlung bus la phyir bzung zhing*/ khog nang gi shugs dbus dang*/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su rdeg par byed pa ni/ nang gi brdeg pa dang*/ phyi la brdeg pa ni/ mgo mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang*/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs pa/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang*/ g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/

de nas langs la/ rkang pa g.yas pa 'phong la lan gsum brdeg /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de'i rjes su 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o// sprug pa la/ nang dang phyi sprug pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil byas la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ rlung nang du drag tu bzung zhing shugs dang ldan pas lan gsum tsam sprug /de nas rlung phyir bus la ha zhes brjod cing drag (273)tu sprug go /de nas mgo mdun rgyab tu bsgyur zhing sprug /g.yas g.yon du gcu zhing sprug /lhag pa bskyed cing sprug /lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor zhing*/ zhags pa 'phen pa'i tshul gyis lan gsum sprug /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ lag pa gnyis ka dus gcig tu lan gsum sprug /de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas lan gsum sprug /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas rlung bsgyur byas la/ lag pa gnyis rgyab tu lag phur btsugs la/ rkang pa g.yas lan gsum brkyang bskum bya/ g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas gan rkyal du rkang lag rnams dus gcig tu sprug cing brkyang bskum bya'o// de rnams sngon 'gro'i tshul du btang nas/ dngos gzhi la thog mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa la// rang nyid yi dam du gsal bas// ye shes kyi phyag rgya la snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom pa'i/ byang chub kyi sems rnams spyi bo nas mar rim las babs te/ rdo rje nor bur sleb par bsams la/ der bzung ba ni/ 'gyur ba drug bya ba/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba dang*/ yan lag bzhi nywa bzhi bsgrims te drag tu bskum pa dang*/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du bsgrim/ mgrin pa te gug pa sogs 'gyur ba drug dang ldan pas steng rlung phyir bsal zhing*/ thur sel drag tu glod la/ spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar sems gtad de/ 'dren pa hi 'dren dang*/ hūm̐ 'dren dang*/ hreṃ 'dren dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rlung hi zhes kha nas sgra dang bcas pas phyir bus la stong 'dren bya/

yang nang du rngubs la sgang 'then bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sna sgo nas hūm̐ gi sgras phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang*/ sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya/ (274)gsum pa ni/ hriṃ gyi sgras/ rlung kha nas phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang*/ sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya'o// de nas seng ge rnam rol gyi phyag rgya'i 'gros spyi dang mthun par bya/ gzhan yang rkang pa cig shos kyi rting pas bol gong mnan la/ lus cung zad rgur/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la btsugs la rlung bzung zhing*/ steng rlung gi shugs gsang gnas su mnan/ 'phong cung zad btegs la slar 'bebs kyi tshul gyis gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba rting pa la thug par bya ba de 'dra lan nyi shu rtsa bdun bya ba las/ dgu dgu'i mtshams su g.yas g.yon du gcud cing gnon pa yang bya'o// gsang rtsa mnan pa'i rkang pa'i bol gong gi thad du/ cig shos kyi rkang pa'i rting pas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam brdeg /gsang ba'i rtsa ba gnon pa rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi rting pa res mos kyis bya'o// khyab par byed pa ni/ rlung bzung ba langs shing shugs dang ldan pas lus rgur te lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pas bzung ba mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang pa'i brang nga yang sa la btsugs/ rlung gi shugs stod kyi phyogs su yong bar byas la/ rkang pa'i brla byin pa la sbyar zhing gnon pa dang steng du bteg cing 'then pa lan 'ga' bya'o// thun rting ma la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas bzung ba sogs res mos bya'o// 'ching bar byed pa/ 'phong stegs cung zad cig bcug la/ tsog pu'i rnam pas rkang pa gnyis kyi mgo mdun du yong bar byas/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba thur du bstan pa lte ba'i smad tsam du thog mar yong bar byas la/ rlung kha sbyar du bzung ba dang*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya zhing*/ thal mo rtse thur bstan de nyid yar drangs te/ mgrin pa'i (275)thad tsam du slebs pa na/ thal sbyar rtse gyen du bstan la/

thad kar yang 'dren ci thub byed/ de mtshams nas langs te/ lag pa gnyis rkang pa la nang nas 'khyud de/ rkang mgo gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la/ lus rgur zhing g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bcud pa'o// dbyings su skyal ba ni/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas lto ba skyor byas te/ rlung kha sbyor bzung zhing gsus pa mdun du ha cang ma 'phel bar byas la/ rlung bum pa can mig thad kar blta zhing lus g.yas gcu g.yon gcu bya/ sems mi rtog par bzhag go /me thab ni/ rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/ lag pa gnyis bsnol bas rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong nas bzung la/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing thog mar lto ba'i smad g.yas su bskor/ g.yon du bskor ba lan gsum gsum bya/ de nas rked pa g.yas su gcu ba dang*/ g.yon du gcu ba dang*/ lus bskyed cing rked pa mdun du phul ba dang lus rgur zhing rgyab tu 'phul ba dang*/ de ka'i ngang nas 'phar zhing rdeg pa rnams lan gsum gsum bya'o// lug gi 'dug stangs ni/ langs la rlung 'khrabs zhig byas/ de nas lus rgur zhing pus mo gnyis bar thag mtho phyed do tsam yod par bcas te sa la btsugs/ lag pa gnyis kyang mdun du mtho gang yod par byas la sa la btsugs/ lag pa g.yon ma gug par bya zhing*/ g.yas pa'i ngar dang gru mo sa la bzhag cing*/ mgo g.yas phyogs sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la lus sprug go /lus 'dar thon pa sprug /g.yon phyogs su'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis car gyi gru mo dang lag ngar sa la bzhag cing*/ (276)dpral ba sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la lus sprug go /byi la'i 'dug stangs ni/ bum pa can bzung zhing rlung 'khrabs zhig byas la/ de nas lus sgur zhing lag pa gnyis mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo gnyis kyang sa la btsugs/ uṃ gi sgras stong 'dren bya zhing*/ mgo dang ro stod rgur/ rgyab shad gyen du 'then ci thub bya/

de nas mgo dang ro stod bsgyed cing*/ lus smad 'gur gyis yong bar bya'o// ce spyang gi 'dug stangs ni/ 'phong sa la ma reg par rkang pa'i brang sa la btsugs/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la bzhag /hūm̐ gi sgras stong 'dren bya'o// de nas seng ge'i rnam rol lo// 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ bum pa can gyi ngang las/ rna ba dpung mgo la thug pa'i mgo g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du lan gsum bskor ba bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor ro// de bzhin du g.yon pa'ang bskor/ lte ba man cher ma yo bar bcas la/ mgo dang ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ pho ba sogs ro smad g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ de nas langs la rkang ba g.yas phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor la/ rkang mgo 'phang la brdeg /rkang pa g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya'o// zhags pa 'phen pa ni/ bum pa can gyi ngang nas/ mgo mdun rgyab tu phyang phyang 'phen pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du'ang 'phen pa ste lan gsum gsum mo// lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo rnams brkyangs te 'phen pa dang*/ khu tshur bcangs te dpung mgo la brdeg pa lan gsum gsum bya zhing g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya/ (277)de nas skyil krung nas btegs par byas la/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba dang yang langs la mdun du kha sbubs byas te dpral ba sa la reg pa tsam yong bar bya ba ste mdun rgyab tu lan gsum dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi pus mo sa las ma btegs par byas la/ mgo g.yas g.yon gyi sa la reg pa tsam yong ba'ang lan gsum gsum bya'o// de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas mdun du lan gsum brkyang bskum byed pa dang*/ de bzhin du g.yas dang rgyab rnams su'ang bya zhing*/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin byas la mthar 'bebs bya'o// ske rags 'ching ba ni/ lag gnyis khu tshur gshib pa rked pa la shugs dang ldan pas ske rags 'ching ba'i tshul bya zhing rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung la/

ro stod cung zad gyen du bsgyed cing lan gsum bya'o// bco brgyad sprug ni/ rlung bzung la bca' gzhi dang bcas langs la/ de nas lag pa gnyis steng du 'phangs pa mnyam du lan gsum 'phar ba dang*/ de nas kyang lan gsum 'og tu sdigs pa dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung la lus sgur zhing dgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni/ steng du 'then pa dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i gshog pa nas bzung la/ dgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni/ thad kar 'then pa dang*/ de nas gan rkyal du byas la/ lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung zhing*/ srub pa dang bcas dgang 'dren stong 'dren bya ba ni/ 'og tu 'then pa dang*/ de nas gan rkyal du bsdad pa'i ngang nas rkang lag bzhi dus gcig tu sprug cing brkyangs bskums lan gsum byas pa'i mthar rgyab 'phar gcig bya'o// de ltar lus spyod (278)dang*/ rlung sbyor de rnams yun ring du goms par byas la/ thog mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang lag pa'i phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rab lam bsgom pa la ye shes cung zad skyes pa/ de ltar min yang dam tshig dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags la mos pa thob pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin no// de nyid kyi thog mar gzugs la blta ba'i rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgoms la/ bzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ dgram pa dang*/ khyab par bya/ de bzhin du sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ phyi'i reg bya rnams la brten nas rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom pa'ang sngar bzhin bslab/ de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lha dang*/ phyag rgya 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mar bsgoms la mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang*/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa'ang dran par byas la/ thabs shes mnyam par sbyar ba'i thog mar dga' ba tsam la bzung bzlog khyab dgram rnams bya/ de nas mchog dga' dang*/ khyad dga' dang*/ mthar lhan skyes kyi bar du bya'o// de yang rtsa mdud cung zad grol ba rnams la dga' ba bzhi 'char ba gsal po shes kyang*/

las dang po pa rnams la gsal por shes pa dka' yang*/ spyi cha shas tsam 'char ba ni nges pa yin no// thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba dang ma bral ba'i dus der bzung ba'i thabs ni 'og sgo drag tu lhod/ steng rlung phyir bus la/ phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya/ yang rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa rnams bya zhing*/ steng rlung nang du rngub pa dang*/ gsang gnas dang*/ bshang sgo'i bar du sdigs shing gtun brdung ba ltar bya ba ni bzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa ni (279)hūm̐ gi sgras stong 'dren bya ba dang*/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba bgrang 'dren bya ba dang*/ ma ning grug gzhung rnams byed do// dgram pa ni nywa bzhi rnams lhod glod pa'o// de nas gong du bstan pa ltar gyis lus sgyong 'khrul 'khor thams cad bya zhing*/ de nas 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung la/ sems kyi rang ngo blta zhing mi rtog par 'jog pa ni/ rlung dang bsre zhing ye shes chen por skyel ba'o// drug pa man ngag thor bu la/ thog mar yi dam bsgom pa'i man ngag ni/ rang gang bsgoms pa'i yi dam rigs gang yin pa brtags te/ rdo rje'i rigs yin na snying ga dang*/ rin po che'i rigs yin na lte ba dang*/ las kyi rigs yin na gsang gnas dang*/ padma'i rigs yin na mgrin pa dang*/ rnam snang rigs yin na spyi bo'i 'khor lor bsgom mo// de yang rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor padma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ dmigs pa gsal na/ de'i thugs kar sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa'ang bsgoms la de rnams la dmigs pa gtad cing*/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i shes pas sngags bzla zhing*/ thun 'jog khar mchod pa dpag tu med pa blos sprul te phul la gsol ba gdab/ thun mtshams su yang kha zas za ba'i tshe/ yi dam la mchod pa phul bar mos so// lha bsgom pa'i tshul 'di ni rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor rnams su bsgoms pas rdzogs rim dang shin tu mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ro// bla ma bsgom pa'i man ngag la/

phyi sgrub dang nang sgrub gnyis las/ dang po la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma bsgom/ (280)de'i thugs kar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa phul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa rnams byas rjes/ bla ma'i mtshan la de nyid gsum spel byas pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ dper na/ oṃ āḥrin chen rdo rje hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma mdun du bsgoms pa de'i thugs khar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'chang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa dang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam pa can/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pas bskor ba bsams la/ phyag 'tshal nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin no// gsum pa ni/ bla ma'i thugs kar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dpal he ru ka'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la/ 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la phyag 'tshal ba sogs gong bzhin no// gnyis pa nang sgrub ni/ mdun du bla ma bsgoms la mos gus dung ba byas gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo padma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ bla ma rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mgrin pa'i bla ma 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po g.yas padma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ snying gar bla ma mi (281)bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa/ lte bar bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gsang gnas su bla ma don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ gnas lngar bla ma rigs lnga yab yum bsgoms la/ bla ma'i mtshan dang*/ rigs lnga so so'i sa bon la de nyid gsum spel ba'i bzlas pa bya ba ste/ oṃ āḥrin chen rdo rje bhrūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ dzriṃ hūm̐ dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ āṃḥhūm̐ dang*/ khaṃ hūm̐ zhes pa rnams btags pa bzla bar bya'o// bar chad bsal ba'i man ngag la/ go rakṣa dang*/ bi rū pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la shes pa gtad de/ 'di ltar du snang ba ni med bzhin du 'khrul pa sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsams la/ de nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas shing btsal ba na/ rig ngor gang yang ma rnyed pa'i ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba de'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni dmigs skor dang po dang*/ de la cung zad goms pa na/ de nas rang dbang ba'i gnas khang dang longs spyod 'khor g.yog la sogs pa rnams la 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsgom pa dang*/ de dag gi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas te ngos bzung bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni dmigs skor gnyis pa (282)dang*/ de nas dgra sdang ba la sngar bzhin bsgom pa dmigs skor gsum pa dang*/ gnyen byams pa la bsgom pa dmigs skor bzhi pa dang*/ de nas mthong thos su gyur pa yul nye sar gnas pa rnams la bsgom pa dmigs skor lnga pa dang*/ mthar snang ba thams cad la bsgom pa dmigs skor drug pa'o// de rnams la rim gyis bslab ste goms par gyur pa na/ thog mar tsha grang la sogs rkyen phran bu la hūm̐ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su bskyel ba dang*/

de nas chags sdang bde sdug 'jigs skrag sogs 'char sgo thams cad hūm̐ gi sgras dbyings su gcod pas rang gi khyim du bsgom zhing*/ de nas dur khrod dang*/ tshong 'dus dang*/ 'dre gdon gyi gnas rnams su smyon par brdzus te phyin pa na/ der 'dre gdon gyi cho 'phrul dang*/ skye bo rnams kyi bstod smad sogs rkyen bzang ngan thams cad hūm̐ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su bskyal lo// gnyis pa bi rū pa'i lugs la yang*/ las dang po pa'i nyams len dang*/ rang gi khyim du rkyen dang bsre/ mthar dur khrod la sogs par rgyu ba ste sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po la/ snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ stong nyid bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ 'di dag gis bskyed pa'i gnod pa bdag la byung ba'ang skye shi 'phos nas ngo ma shes pas len pa yin snyam du bsams la snying rje drag tu bsgom pa ni dmigs skor dang po dang*/ de nas bdag bde ba 'dod pa bzhin du sems can rnams kyang bde ba 'dod/ bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du sems can rnams kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pas/ de (283)ltar na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor gnyis pa dang*/ de nas sems can rnams nyon mongs pas sems dkrugs te las bsags/ des 'khor bar 'khyams te sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor gsum pa dang*/ de nas don dam par sems can kyang bden par ma grub/ de dag gis myong ba'i sdug bsngal yang bden par ma grub/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin yang de ltar ma rtogs par sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems las logs su grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor dang po dang*/ de nas sems kyi ngo bo yang ma grub ste/ ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bzhag go /de nas stong pa'i ngang las snang ba thams cad lha skur lam ste bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dag pa'i snang ba bsgom pa dang*/ yang na stong pa'i ngang las ma dag pa'i snang ba bsgom pa ni shar ba'i tshe/ rang gi lus dum bu brgya stong du mar btubs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pas mnyes/ rigs drug rnams rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod byung ste tshim par bsam/ khyad par yang log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams sha khrag gi gtor mas tshim par mos/ mthar de rnams kyi sems dang rang gi sems stong pa nyid du bsres la mnyam par bzhag go /de (284)rnams la cung zad goms par gyur pa na/ rang khyim du tsha grang la sogs pa'i rkyen ched gtad yong bar byas te/ stong nyid snying rje lam du khyer/ de nas rang khyim du rkyen sna tshogs dang bsre ba la goms pa na/ dur khrod dang*/ tshong 'dus dang*/ 'dre gdon thams cad kyi gnas su phyin la rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang bsre bar bya'o// sems 'dzin gyi man ngag la/ spyir bka' babs drug ldan gyi man ngag 'di la sems 'dzin gyi rnam grangs lnga brgya tsam yod kyang*/ 'dir dkyus su gsungs pa la bcu drug tsam las/ thog mar zhag 'ga' lus gnad ji ltar bde ba zhig bcas la/ bya byed thams cad spangs te gang yang mi bsgom par bsdad/ de nas tho rangs lta bu rig pa dwangs pa zhig la/ rang nyid kyi lus ri zhig tu gyur par bsams la/ de'i ri sul dang*/ de la gnas pa'i shing dang chu 'bab tshul sogs la rim gyis sems gtad/ yang 'phro bcad cing bsgom pa ni dmigs pa dang po dang yang rang gi lte ba'i thad tsam du ne'u seng yid du 'ong ba zhig bsam/

de'i phyogs zhig tu shing sdong po lo 'dab ldan pa zhig ldem cug ge 'dug pa la sems gtad cing*/ yang 'phro bcad kyin bsgom pa ni dmigs pa gnyis pa dang*/ yang rang gi snying ga'i thad du sa gzhi'i dbus su mtsho shin tu dwangs pa me re ba la chu gnyer shig shig 'dug pa la sems 'dzin zhing*/ slar 'phro bcad kyin bsgom pa ni dmigs pa gsum pa dang*/ yang rang nyid kyi spyi bo'i steng na nam mkha' de'i yang steng na rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ de'i steng na sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de'i steng na gzugs khams/ de'i steng na gzugs med khams/ de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas gzugs med kyi khams (285)kyi bar dang*/ de'i steng na yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas gzugs med khams kyi bar la sems gtad pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs par bsams la/ der shes pa gtad cing slar 'phro bcad kyin yang yang bsgom pa ni dmigs pa bzhi pa dang*/ yang rang gi 'og phyogs na sa yi dkyil 'khor dang*/ dmyal ba'i gnas rnams rim pa bzhin dang*/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i 'og na rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i 'og na 'jig rten khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar dang*/ de'i yang 'og nas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar la shes pa gtod pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang po bzhugs par bsams la de la sems cung zad cig gtad/ slar 'phro bcad kyin bsgom pa ni dmigs pa lnga pa dang*/ yang yid kyi pho nya btang ba bya ba/ rang nyid 'di nyid na yod par bsams pa'i/ rang gnyis pa zhig phar 'gro bar bsam/ rgyang tsam du slebs pa na/ des tshur blta zhing*/ 'di nas kyang phar bltas par bsams la/ de gnyis rim pas ri brgal te thag ring por phyin pa na/

yang 'di nas phar blta ba dang*/ phar nas tshur blta bar bsam pa ni dmigs pa drug pa dang*/ yang rang nyid kyi 'og phyogs lta bu zhig tu mtsho chung ngu zhig bsgom/ de rim pas je che dang*/ dbang je mtho la song nas/ mthar rang gi steng dang phyogs thams cad chus bskor ba'i dbus na/ rang nyid 'dug par bsam pa ni dmigs pa bdun pa dang*/ yang rang gi mdun (286)lta bu phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu/ dmigs rten gyi mar me zhig bzhag /de la skabs skabs su cung zad blta zhing*/ gzhan yid kyis mar me g.yo ba med pa zhig bsgom ste/ de la sems 'dzin pa ni dmigs pa brgyad pa dang*/ yang rang gi gsang gnas su mar me dgu rab tu g.yo ba la sems 'dzin pa ni dgu pa dang*/ yang rang nyid yul gang la sems 'phro bar gyur pa'i dngos po zhig la yid gtod 'jog /gzhan la sems 'phro na de la 'phro ba bcad de// slar dmigs rten snga ma de ka la sems 'jog pa ni bcu pa dang*/ yang rang gi yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po zhig la sems 'dzin rnam rtog gzhan 'phro na/ slar rang gi gang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po de ka la sems 'jog pa ni dmigs pa bcu gcig pa dang*/ yang lus gnad rkang pa mdun du gshibs/ rgyu mo khung gnyis nas lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung la/ de'i thad kyi rkang mthil du 'od zer 'phro ba la sems 'dzin pa'am/ yang na shing ril mo sbam phra 'tshams pa zhig rkang pa'i rgyu mo khung du bcug /rkang sor g.yas g.yon lag pas cung zad bzung la/ shing gis reg pa'i reg bya yod pa der sems gtod pa ni gdan khri la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu gnyis pa dang*/ yang shog bu'am ras lta bu'am gzhi sngon po de'i dbus su ljon shing ngam ri lta bu zhig bri/ de'i rtsa bar mi yi gzugs brnyan zhig dris la/ de mdun du dmigs rten du bzhag la/ gzhi sngon po// ne'u seng dang*/ de'i dbus su ri'am ljon shing gang rung zhig la rang nyid bskor ba byed pa ni dmigs pa bcu gsum pa dang*/

yang rang gi spyi bor shing lta bu zhig btsugs la/ de'i reg bya yod par nor bu 'od 'phro ba zhig la sems 'dzin pa ni gtsug gi nor bu (287)la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang*/ spyi bor shing lta bu 'jog pa mi bde na/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag go /yang lag pa gnyis khu tshur brla steng du bzhag /ro stod dang ltag pa bsgyed byas la/ gdong gyen du phyogs pas mig bar snang la blta/ lus kyi dbus su 'od kyi gong bu kha dog ji ltar bde ba zhig bsgoms la/ de lus kyi dbus nas yar song*/ spyi bo nas thon/ nam mkha' mthon por yal bar bsgom pa ni dmigs pa bcu drug pa'o// gegs sel gyi man ngag la/ rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le la brten pa'i gegs gang yin ngos zin par byas la/ grang ba'i nad rnams lte ba'i 'khor lo'i byed pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ thog mar bar rlung bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas rlung ro bsal steng rlung rngub cing 'og rlung 'then la rlung gnyis kha sbyor du bzung*/ lte ba g.yas g.yon du lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ steng du 'then pa dang*/ 'og tu gnon pa dang*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer te rgyab ngos su 'then pa dang*/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa rnams byas la rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe/ grang ba'i nad sogs mi bde ba gang yin pa de 'od zer 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas sna sgo dang 'og sgo gnyis nas kyang bun bun thon par bsam mo// rlung phyi rol du 'dzin pa'i ngang nas/ khong nas stong pa'i shugs g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ steng 'og tu 'then gnon byed pa dang*/ rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byed do/ khrag sogs tsha ba'i nad rnams lus kyi stod du 'byung bas/ de sel ba sngar bar rlung bzung*/ de rjes rlung rngubs te kha sbyor du bzung*/ (288)de nyid pho stod du drangs pa la pho stod dang*/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/

steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang*/ rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byas la/ rlung phyir btang ba'i tshe/ sna bug dang 'og sgo gnyis nas nad 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas thon par bsam/ rlung phyir bzung la de nyid stod kyi char 'then byas te mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang*/ mdun rgyab tu bcol ba rnams byed pa dang*/ lag pa bskor la brkyang bskum byed cing sprug pa dang*/ rkang pa yang brkyang bskum byed cing sprug pa/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe nad rnams dbang po'i sgo rnams dang*/ mgrin pa yan gyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams dang*/ rkang lag gi sen mo'i gseb rnams nas bun bun thon par bsam/ rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pas mgo bo bskor ba sogs bya'o// rlung rengs bcu'i gegs sel ni/ bum pa can la sogs pa'i rlung gi sbyor ba bsgom pa'i gegs byung ba'am/ de lta min yang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gang rung bsgoms pas rlung 'du bar 'gyur zhing*/ de la brten nas gegs byung na gegs sel gyi man ngag 'di rnams bsgom dgos pa yin no// de yang srog rlung la skyon zhugs te ro stod gzer ba dang*/ snying mi dga' ba dang*/ shes pa 'phyo ba la sogs byung na rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor sems drag tu gtad la/ sngar bum pa can la sogs goms pa zhig yin na/ thur sel 'then 'then byed pa yin zhing*/ de lta min na steng rlung gsar gnas su mnan pa/ 'og rlung rnams rdo rje nor bur yal bar bsam pa yang yang bsgoms pas sel lo// ro stod la chu tshan sogs chu dron mos bran pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro// (289)me mnyam la skyon zhugs na/ pho ba sbo 'khrogs dang sgregs skyug sogs 'byung bas/ de la sems mgrin par gtad la bar rlung bzung zhing*/ lto ba'i smad bar rlung yod par bskor ba dang*/ pho stod bskor bar byas pas sel lo// 'di la lto ba la thog mar chang gi bshugs pa byas la/

de nas bye ma bsregs ma lta bu gang yang rung bas grang dugs byas pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro// thur sel la skyon zhugs te chu lam dang*/ bshang lam du na tsha skye ba dang*/ bshang gci bsdoms pa dang*/ bshang gci mi thon pa sogs byung na sems spyi bor gtad la/ bshang lam dang chu lam gyi sar dang*/ tshang ra la sogs par khu tshur brdeg cing 'phur mnye byas pas sel lo// gyen rgyu'i rlung rengs na/ mgrin pa 'gags pa dang*/ nang du sha skye ba dang*/ gre ba tsha ba la sogs pa dang*/ sna bug tsha ba la sogs pa 'byung zhing*/ de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngubs la/ rlung bzung zhing mgo bo bskor bar bya/ drag tu rlung bus la yang mgo bskor ro// 'di la mgrin pa'i bum can lta bu dang sbrags te mgo bskor bar byas na/ gegs sel mchog tu 'gro'o// khyab byed kyi rlung rengs na/ lus thams cad na ba'am/ sbrid pa'am/ lus khol bu khol bur tsha tsag pa la sogs 'byung bas/ yan lag thams cad sprug cing*/ lus 'dar phrug phrug bya'o// 'di la rdzas kyi khyad par snum dang g.yer ma bsres pas lus la byugs pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi khyad par/ ka pā la ā sa na bya ba/ spyi bo sa la btsugs/ rkang pa gnyis gnam du bstan pa'i lus spyod byas pa'i kyang sel bar 'gyur ro// yan lag gi rlung rengs pa sel ba la/ mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung (290)rengs te/ mig tsha ba dang mi gsal bar 'gro ba la sogs byung na/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i bum pa can bzung la shugs dang ldan pas mig drag tu g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ yas mar du blta ba rnams byas la mthar rlung 'bud cing lus drag tu sprug go /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par tsha ba la brten te mig na na gur gum sogs 'debs pa dang*/ grang ba la brten na skyer pa'i khaṇḍa sogs byug cing*/ snga dro so brdar ba byugs pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro// rna bar rgyu ba'i rlungs rengs na/ rna bar 'ur ba dang*/

na zug skye ba la sogs pa 'byung bas de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba bsgyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ rna ba mi bde ba'i phyogs de bkab cing*/ mthar drag tu 'bud pa'i tshe rlung rnams rna ba mi na ba'i phyogs nas 'thon par bsams la/ lus thams cad drag tu sprug go /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par dri chu dron mos rna ba bkang ste mthar phyir 'bo'o// yang dag par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ sna bug gi lam tsha ba sogs mi bde ba 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon res mos kyis sna'i rtse nas bzung ste mnye ba dang*/ bya gshog g.yas g.yon nas dus gcig tu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi bzung la mnye zhing*/ mthar drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprug go /rab tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lce mi bde ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ thor ba skye ba sogs 'byung bas de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba phyir bsgyed pa'i bum pa can bzung la/ lce brkyangs shing bsgril la rkan la sbyor ci thub bya ba lan mang du byas pa'i mthar/ rlung drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprug go /nges (291)par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lus thams cad na ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ lus khol bur na ba sogs 'byung bas de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngubs la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i bum pa can bzung la/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo gcan gzan gyi sder mo ltar bskums la/ nywa bzhi bsgrim pas sprug pa dang*/ rkang pa'i sor mo yang bskums la nywa bzhi bsgrim pas sprug pa dang*/ kha bgrad pas nywa bzhi bsgrims la mgo sprug pa dang*/ ro stod gcu ba dang*/ rgya mtsho bskyod pa sogs byas la/ mthar rlung drag tu 'bud cing*/ lus thams cad sprug go /tsha ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'od zer dkar po shin tu bsil ba 'phro ba las/

bdud rtsi reg bya shin tu bsil ba babs te/ 'od zer dang bdud rtsis lus kyi nang grang bsil bsil gyur pa la sems gtad pas sel lo// grang ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi lte ba'am gsang gnas su a yig dmar po shin tu tsha ba'i rang bzhin can las/ 'od zer dmar po reg bya shin tu tsha ba 'phros te/ des lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tsha 'ur re gyur par bsams pas sel lo// 'dus pa'i nad kyis lus lji bar gyur na/ gsang gnas su yaṃ yig shin tu g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can bsgoms la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus kyi sha khrag lpags pa rus pa brjid med pa du ba 'dra ba zhig tu gyur pa yaṃ las 'phros pa'i rlung gis yar yar gyen du 'degs par bsams pas sel lo// gzhan yang rlung rengs pa ste/ rtsa gnas su 'gags pa'i gegs sel spyi khyab ni/ rang gi lus kyi gnas thams cad nas rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pa rta rnga lta bu rkang dang (292)bcas pa byung ste bshang sgo nas 'thon sa 'og thag ring por song ste mthar yal bar bsam/ 'di la 'khrul 'khor yang langs te rkang pa gnyis drag tu bsgrad pa dang bshang sgo phyir phul zhing lhod pas kyang sel lo// yang rlung rtsa gnas rnams su 'khyil ba'i gegs ni/ rlung rengs pa las gegs dang mi bde ba'i rnam pa cha phra bar 'byung ste de sel ba la/ rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas lus kyi nang nas yar byung ste/ spyi bo nas thon pa bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing ha ring dang*/ ha thung yang 'don no// gzhan yang gzer lus kyi dbus su steng 'og tu 'byung ba'am/ stod kyi char rgyab mdun du gzer ba lta bu byung na/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis steng du gzer ba la steng nas mnan par bsam zhing*/ mdun rgyab tu gzer na rdo rje rgya gram gyis nang nas mdun phyogs su mnan par bsam mo// 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ ro stod dang*/ lto ba dang*/ rgyu zhabs rnams nas mi bde bar gyur na/

thad de dang der 'khor lo rtse mo shin tu rno ba kha dog ji ltar rigs pa zhig bsgoms la/ de drag tu 'khor bas je cher gyur te/ rtsibs rnams kyis yongs su bcad pa'i lus kyi phyi na mar thon pas lus nyid smad har gyis bcad par bsam/ 'di la rlung sbyor bum can gang na sar sdigs par byed pa'o// srad bu la brten pa ni/ rang gang na sar srad bu gru gu lta bu zhig yod pa de nar gyis phar song*/ lus kyi na sar bu ga byung ste song ba sne gcig lus nang na thogs par yod pa ste/ slar gru gu 'gril ba ltar phar hril te 'gril bar bsam/ de lta bu yang yang bsgom zhing*/ rkang sbyor bu ga nas srad bu phar 'gro ba'i tshe/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas drag tu (293)'bud do// bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba ni/ lus thams cad tshags se ltar khrol tshags su 'dug pa la/ 'bebs chung dang bcas ha bton pas/ rlung rnams du ba'i rnam pas bu ga nas bun bun thon par bsam mo// 'khor lo med pa ni/ rang gi gsang gnas yan chad dang*/ mgrin pa man chad kyi lus sba dong lta bu stod smad zang thal du yod pa dbang mtho ba zhig bsgom/ shes pa bying ba dang*/ thur sel la skyon zhugs pa'i nad dang*/ chu ser dang*/ grang ba sogs kyis rked pa man chad na na/ 'og nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa/ rang lus sba dong lta bu'i nang na yar shong tshad du song*/ steng gi bu ga nas thon/ bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas drag tu bus la/ lag pa drag tu sprug go /yang rgod pa shas che ba dang*/ lte ba yan chad na na/ steng phyogs kyis nam mkha' nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ lus sba dongs lta bu'i nang nas mar zhugs te song*/ sa 'og thag ring por yal bar bsam/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas rngubs la/ sdod yod na 'bebs chung bya ba'am/ langs nas rkang pa gnyis res mos kyis drag tu sprug go /lus rab tu zhu ba'i sbyor ba ni/

rang gi 'og tu thog mar mtsho chung mar khu'am chu dron lta bus gang ba zhig bsams la/ de ka cher gyur ba'i nang du rang gi lus kyang rim pas nub ste/ spyi bo man de'i nang du nub cing bying ba na/ rang gi lus yongs su zhu ste de dang 'dres par bsam/ 'dis ni sems mi gnas par rnam rtog drag tu 'phro ba'i gegs sel lo// bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa ni/ mnyam bzhag tu rtog med rnam par mi rtog pa sgom par byed pa zhig yod na/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs*/ (294)thun mtshams rnams su yang dran so'i rten dngos po ji ltar rigs pa zhig bzhag la/ de yang yang mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ mi rtog pa yang yang dran par byas ste bsgoms kyang mnyam bzhag la bogs thon par 'gyur ro// yang mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo lta bu rtog bcas kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed pa zhig yin na/ thun mtshams rnams su/ dper na/ zas za ba'i tshe/ zas kyi dbus su gtum mo aṃ yi ge sgom bar byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang gtam smra ba'i tshe/ de'i kha'i nang du gtum mo aṃ yig sgom par byed pa sogs la bslab pas kyang bogs thon par 'gyur ro// gzhan bla ma yi dam rang gang mos zhig bar snang thag ring por bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid ljon shing lta bu zhig la 'dzegs te yar phyin zhing*/ bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa dang thad mnyam par sleb pa na/ 'di dag thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba tsam yin/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad gtad la/ rang dang bla ma yi dam dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thag bcad de/ yid la mi byed pa'i tshul gyis cung zad mnyam par bzhag /yang de las langs te bla ma yi dam de las kyang mtho ba'i nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid nyi zla'i 'od zer ram/ ljon shing lta bu gang rung zhig la 'dzegs te phyin pa na/ bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa'i thad dang mnyam par sleb pa na/

sngar bzhin stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa sogs mtha' med kyi bar du byas pas kyang ting nge 'dzin thams cad la bogs thon zhing yon tan yar 'phel du 'gyur ro// 'dir smras pa/ tshangs sogs grags ldan lha yis btud (295)pa'i 'od kyis phyogs kun mtha' bskor zhing*// thugs rje'i cha shas yongs su gang bar grub pa'i rtags ris ma nyams pa// bgrang yas lus can rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur phan bde'i bdud rtsis spro ba mkhan// dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje'i zla ba 'phags yul shar ri'i phrag par shar// gang des dngos grub mchog brnyes bye ba brgya'i// rmad byung phan bde'i lam bzang ji snyed pa// gcig tu dril ba rdo rje'i theg pa yi// rim gnyis rnal 'byor mchog gi dga' ston bskrun// gang 'di rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bshes gnyen dam par snang ba kun dga'i mtshan// 'dren pa mchog des gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru// ston med legs bshad gsal ba'i bdud bkye// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kyi// snying po las kyang ches snying po// 'di bris dge ba gang thob pas// zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bgyis pa'o/// maṅga lam/// / (296)
